title: The American Town You Can Only Reach Through Canada
description:
Point Roberts, Washington is a piece of the United States you can only reach by driving through another country. This is the true story of how a single line drawn on a map in 1846 stranded an American town on the wrong side of the border, and what it reveals about how the modern world map was really made.
